notes: 修好「手动关掉进度窗口会把刚重启的客户端一起关掉」：重启原先是在进度窗口（控制台程序）里直接 Start-Process 拉起客户端，客户端因此进了那个控制台的作业；点窗口的 × 时 conhost 清理作业，客户端被连坐结束（等窗口自己跑完退出则不受影响，所以现象时好时坏）。现在改用 explorer 代启，客户端与进度窗口没有父子/作业关系，关窗口不再影响它；explorer 不可用时才退回原方式并在日志里标明。
notesEn: Fixes "closing the progress window also kills the freshly relaunched client": the relaunch used to be a Start-Process from that progress window (a console program), so the new client landed in the same console job; clicking the window's X makes conhost tear the job down and takes the client with it (letting the window finish on its own does not, which is why it looked intermittent). The client is now started through explorer, so it has no parent/job relation to the progress window and closing it no longer matters; the old way is kept only as a logged fallback when explorer is unavailable.
